a.text: There are some things that will never change, Ailshie!
I'll grow up to be a Steam Knight, just like Sir Lynch! No, even greater than Sir Lynch!
I'll protect you all, and I'll drive every scoundrel away.
I'll uphold the glory of Cumberland, just like my great-great-great-great grandmother!
I promise this, Ailshie! You'll see!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hold on! I, I'll...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I promised that I'd...
Go, Allerdale.
The Vampire is coming. He cannot find you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie is here. I have to—
You have to follow her orders. She will not allow you to deviate.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Y-You can't...
We can. The Duke has ordered us to help you 'complete your mission', but we are not your servants.
Do not forget her instructions.
Do not forget your place.
There is only one thing that you must do. Fulfill your duty.
For an instant, Allerdale forgets where she is, and who is with her.
She wants to run, towards the fire that is burning away at what little remains of her life.
Just like that night twenty-six years ago, when she wanted to run towards another fire to stop Parliament's men from taking her father.
That is your sole responsibility.
Allerdale's eyes open wide. The tears in them evaporate before the fire.
But she sees a great silhouette is rising in the burning garden.
Is it the damaged suit of steam armor? The steam armor upon which she placed so many dreams and hopes?
Return to the person of interest. Now.
Through so many trials and tribulations, Allerdale had prayed that her great ancestor would descend into the steam armor and help her overcome all challenges.
Now she sees the ancient armor breathing the flames of hell.
She sees the shadow in the fire roar towards her.
It is not her hope. She has strayed far from it.
Even if her ancestor truly returned—
Allerdale knows it could only be her worst nightmare.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Tell her.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I will obey her will, as always.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I, I don't understand, Your Highness...

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I thought you were pleased with our hospitality...

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: You even graced us with your presence at our banquets, did you not? You liked this place!

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I will not deny that you have brought me joy, from time to time.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I find your petty flattery and exaggerated cordiality adorable.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: You must be mistaken! I have no links to the dukes or the resistance! I swear...

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Any trouble must be the work of the Cumberland woman! I'll expose her!

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Sanguinarch... Your Highness... please, I'll give you anything! My collection, my money... take all of it! Just...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: What good are those to me, my dear?

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: You wouldn't kill me, would you? We should hold a wine tasting! You haven't sampled my private reserve yet...

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I'll be alright, won't I, Lt. Colonel Lettou? This is Londinium!

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: They—the Sarkaz are just here to protect Londinium at the invitation of the Duke of Cavendish? They wouldn't kill an innocent, of course?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Take him to the front.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I tire of the noise. Begin.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: B-Begin what?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Run in when you hear the order.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Confirm everyone is dead and you can come back alive.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: In... into the fire? A fire that big? N-No! I'll burn to death!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're going to do exactly that.
The ancient Sarkaz steps on the Heart of Victoria and raises a finger.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Argh—!
He did not see what was chasing him.
As the Sarkaz warrior said, he follows the order instinctively, running forward like a man possessed.
In the fire, the slightest chance of survival. On his tail, the scent of certain death.
But he only takes a few steps before stumbling in confusion.
Blood spurts from his body.
It no longer belongs to him. It serves another master now.
At its new master's command, it charges forth towards the collapsing manor, towards the raging flames, chewing through the ruins, swallowing the rubble, covering the cinders.
Nothing can stop the march of blood, not even fire.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He was right, Lettou.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I haven't sampled his private reserve.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: We should, shouldn't we?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: This is it. Wait here.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Lund, Charlie...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: This is where you kill us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: ...How do you know?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Simple.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You never told the workers what you were building for the past two years.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But a factory boss gets a few clues.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I guessed you were close to the final stages, the way you people have been pressing us lately. And that means it's time for those who know too much to die.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: You lied to me.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Just getting my affairs in order.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What could lowly workers like us do, after groveling for the past three years?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Don't you dare try anything.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: You, you and you. Come with me; we'll take a look around.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Keep a close eye on her, Paprika.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Can I have a smoke?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hm... okay.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Did you ever consider running?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Where?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: And anyway, it'd only make trouble for the workers left behind.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I've been thinking about what you'd do to us. Looks like whoever's giving the orders still has something of a heart.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But... what do you mean?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: They said to get rid of us quietly so the workers don't panic, didn't they?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: If my life buys a chance for the others to live, then so be it.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You think the rest of the old timers you brought here don't get that?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I don't get it...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: How old are you, girl?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, do you know the story of the Steam Knights?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny used to build them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It was a point of pride for us.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: With our own hands, we built the armor worn by the defenders of Londinium, the ones who defended our home.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I wanted to see the birth of those great things, just like Granny... to take part in it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny's been through a lot. She saw how Londinium became what it is today. And I can see how disappointed she is.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I don't want to give up so soon.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Must be this drawer.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hidden compartment... hidden compartment... ah, here it is.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny's incredible. I'd never know this desk had been altered, if she hadn't told me.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This is... my badge?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: And a notebook?

a.text: I don't know who I'm writing this for, what I'm writing this for.
Harvey died before Feist was born.
Lindy tried to understand, but her sorrow turned into anger towards me. She blamed me for not stopping Harvey that day.
I couldn't argue with her. I couldn't blame her for leaving Feist behind.
I heard she remarried someone decent. Good for her.
I never told Feist. I didn't want him to know that his father died for nothing, and that his mother left with hate in her heart.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: So you grew up in Columbia.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Yes, my grandma raised me.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Mom and Dad were both mercenaries, but they're dead.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Why did you become a mercenary, then?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: To feed myself, and grandma.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Sarkaz aren't welcome most places, so I had to be a merc.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What a good girl.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: So you agree with the Regent?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: You mean with occupying the city?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Hmm... I don't know.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: We do what we're paid to do. I didn't know we were going to occupy such a big city.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: In Columbia, we were helping merchants smuggle goods that they didn't want people to know about, or hunting wild beasts.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But I can tell you, that was the first time I saw Grimm so excited. He said the Sarkaz would get to live a decent life, if we were successful.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Grimm? The smoker?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Where's he now? I haven't seen him around in a while.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: He's dead.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Aren't you sad about that?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: He always said that death and parting are a normal part of the mercenary life.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Death and parting. All these years of chaos, and the Victorians haven't learned the slightest thing about the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Catch, girl.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Huh?
Catherine takes a little thing from her cigarette box and tosses it at Paprika.
It is small, soft, made of wool, and bright in color.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: This is... a finger sleeve...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Grimm...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You made it for the old merc, didn't you?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: His finger hurt because of an old wound, but he couldn't cut the smoking habit. I saw him hide it in his cigarette box.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Guess he didn't want to get it dirty, even though you made it for him to use.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: He gave me the box when he left. Payment for smokes, those few months.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: He never talked about you, but the moment I saw you, I knew you were the girl he was always thinking about.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... I don't...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I don't know what he thought about the war.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But I know, without hearing it from him... you don't know what war is.

a.text: I had a feeling Feist would leave.
He's too much like Harvey.
He thinks he can solve every problem with his wits.
Seeing him reminds me of Harvey.
I can't tell if I'm disappointed because the protest failed, or because Harvey didn't understand what the nobles were made of.
Maybe a little bit of both.
I let Feist go.
I knew I couldn't stop him.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, I thought about what I was going to say to Granny, before I brought you back.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I thought I was prepared. We've seen so much in our time.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I think I owe her an apology.

options: She doesn't need your apology, does she?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Catherine always looks strict and solemn. People forget that she's just an ordinary woman, who lost her livelihood.

a.text: The Sarkaz don't let workers into certain areas of the factories. They're definitely preparing some sort of weapon.
They shouldn't have the resources to hold out this long, not with the dukes breathing down their necks.
But from the material being sent to the factories, with what I know of their situation, all the signs point to them having their own supply line.
None of this was supposed to concern me.
All I can do is protect the workers.
But—
I noted things I shouldn't have.
Maybe, deep down, I thought I could do more than I did when I watched Harvey go out into the streets, if Feist came back to me for help someday.
Workers aren't allowed near it, but I know the place too well.
There are only a few places suitable for a supply depot.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Here, Doctor! Granny circled some places on the map.

options: I hope we get results on the other side.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yes, it'll be hard to get close to the depots.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This information will help, though, even if we can't get close.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I wish I could say goodbye to Granny.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Guess it'll have to wait until next time.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's go, Doctor.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: A lot of us don't actually know what we're fighting for.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: It's just, we don't have a place to go. We're not welcome anywhere.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: The King of Sarkaz promised us a home, a country, a future.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I've spent time with you people. I can tell that some of you haven't actually fought before.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I can fight!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Have you killed anyone, girl? And I'm not talking about a villain you can kill without remorse... I mean real people.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: You're just a worker. You haven't killed anyone. Don't talk to me like you know what it means.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You've been in Londinium for a while. You've heard of steam armor, haven't you?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I heard it's a powerful weapon that hasn't been seen for a long time.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Yes. It's a killing machine.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I built killing machine after killing machine with these hands right here.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I don't feel ashamed, because those machines were used to defend the land I lived on.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What about you, girl? Do you know what your weapon is for?
